title: Blender `Glass BSDF` shader is imported as plain white color
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] | Blender 4.2

### System information

- CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G 
- GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (8 GB) (driver v566.36)
- OS: Windows 10 22H2
- Godot: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
- Godot Renderer: Compatibility

### Issue description

When import a model from blender that has `Glass BSDF` shader on it, in godot it is being imported just as plain white material

### Steps to reproduce

## Blender

>[!NOTE]
>Result model is included in MRP so you can skip this section if you want

1. Open new `General` project in Blender
2. Clear scene with `a -> x`
3. Add a cube (`Shift+a -> Mesh -> Cube` )
4. Go to `Shading` tab
5. Create a new material
6. Replace `Principled BSDF` node with `Glass BSDF` node (result should look like this)
   
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6159369e-7699-45c4-b827-e643cdf19773)

7. Export the model (`File -> Export -> glTF 2.0 (.glb/.gltf)`) (as glb)
## Godot

1. Create new project
2. import the model's `.glb` file
3. Double click it to open
4. See that cube is just white 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ed21bf3-1f9c-4f43-884f-c73abe8da5ab)

5. And the material itself 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/abb2733b-6804-4577-b977-c1b1a714a052)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[cube_test_2025-05-01_22-00-11.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20002598/cube_test_2025-05-01_22-00-11.zip)
